ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Government Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the various forms of government fraud, including SNAP fraud and housing program fraud, and follow the money to determine the extent of the fraud and who is responsible.
questions: What is the extent of government fraud?
Who is responsible for the fraud?
ideas.insight: I believe this story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and hold those responsible accountable. By following the money and conducting a thorough investigation, we can determine the extent of the fraud and bring those responsible to justice.
